posts.title: Playing to learn
posts.description: I learn by diving deep into whatever has my attention right now. I immerse myself fully. I read it, watch it, listen to it. And as soon as I feel comfortable, I start doing. posts.title: Shut your ears
posts.description: Pace. It's a very personal thing. For some, my pace would feel dangerously fast. For others - slow as hell. If you're building something - anything - don't listen too much to advice about how quickly you should execute. There are always nuances nobody but you understands. posts.title: Time to go
posts.description: It feels as if I’m tied to the shore. As if something - whatever it is that binds me - won't allow me to drift into the open, into the deep waters. Tied here, I've already found comfort. At some point, I realize there is no rope, and the vast depths are entirely within reach. It has been fear - and that quiet sense of comfort, of calm.
